lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
    by_contra h₀
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp h₀
    have hinner : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
      Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
    have hself : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (real_inner_self_nonneg') fun h => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      ((hinner.continuousAt).preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hself))
    obtain ⟨φ, hts, hcs, hc, hr, hφx₀⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ hδpos)
    have key_integral := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
      (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hc, hcs⟩ contDiff_const)
    simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key_integral
    exact (Continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
        (x := x₀) (hc.continuous.mul hinner) hcs.mul_right
        (fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then by simp [h] else
          mul_nonneg (hr (Set.mem_range_self x)).1 (hδ (hts (subset_closure h))).le)
        (by simp [hφx₀, hself.ne'])).ne key_integral.symm

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJd : Differentiable ℝ J := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time hJd x i
  calc _
    _= 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
        rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub]
        simp only [one_div, mul_inv_rev, FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply,
          fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
          fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
          fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt,
          Time.deriv_eq, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
        · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
        · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        simp only [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        congr
        funext k
        rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
        simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt
          (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
        apply hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis i _ x, fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis i _ x]
        exact congrArg (· x)
          (Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) (hEs j))
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ] at h
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1, 2, 2, 2, x]
          rw [show ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x = (1/𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t x from
            (h t x).1.trans (by ring)]
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis i _ x,
          fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.differentiableAt
            (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t))]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, 𝓕.c_sq, mul_comm]
        ring

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit)
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
    (InitStatesNodup Hinit), ?_⟩
  simp only [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup, updatedStates,
    updatedStatesComm (kvs := ks.zip vs) (kvs' := ks'.zip vs') (by
      simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength Hup, InitStatesLength Hinit]
      exact fun a Ha Hb =>
        Bool.noConfusion (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit a Hb ▸
          UpdateStatesDefined Hup a Ha))]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength Hup)
    (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))

theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro Hnorm
  induction Hnorm
  case app _ _ h3 ih1 ih2 =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . intro x hx
      exact hx
    . rename_i Hfalse
      cases h3 IsOldPred.oldPred
      cases Hfalse _ _ _ rfl
    . exact List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ ih1,
      List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ ih2⟩
  case quant _ _ ih1 ih2 | eq _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
    exact List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ ih1)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ ih2)
  case ite _ _ _ ih1 ih2 ih3 =>
    exact List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _
      (List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ ih1,
        List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ ih2⟩), List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ ih3⟩
  all_goals
    first
      | apply List.nil_subset
      | assumption

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJd : Differentiable ℝ J := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time hJd x i
  have hswap : ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x := by
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis i _ x, fderiv_fun_sum]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    congr
    funext j
    rw [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis i _ x]
    exact congrArg (· x)
      (Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) (hEs j))
    intro j _
    exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
  calc _
    _= 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
        rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub]
        simp only [one_div, mul_inv_rev, FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply,
          fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
          fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
          fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt,
          Time.deriv_eq, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
        · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
        · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        simp only [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        congr
        funext k
        rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
        simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt
          (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
        apply hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
    _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
        𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
        𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ] at h
        have hc : 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) = 𝓕.c ^ 2 := by rw [𝓕.c_sq, mul_comm]
        rw [hc, hswap]
        rw [show (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
            fun y => (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y from
          funext fun y => (h t y).1.trans (by ring)]
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis i _ x,
          fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.differentiableAt
            (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t))]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, 𝓕.c_sq, mul_comm]
        ring

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    obtain val_l | ⟨_, h⟩ := ih_l rfl l
    · grind only [→ canonical_form_abs, → Red.abs, → Red.appᵣ]
    · grind [→ Red.appₗ]
  case let' => grind only [→ Red.let_bind, → Red.let_body, body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1]
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain val | ⟨_, h⟩ := ih rfl der
    · grind only [→ canonical_form_sum, → Red.case_inl, → Red.case_inr, body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1]
    · grind [→ Red.case, body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1]
  all_goals grind [→ Red.inl, → Red.inr, → Red.tabs, → Red.tapp, → canonical_form_tabs]

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  induction (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis b) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨φs, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    induction (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis a) using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨φs', rfl⟩ := hy
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
      have hmid : ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF =
          ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) := by
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      let l := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
      let l' := List.filter (fun c =>
        crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
      let r := List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
      let r' := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
        (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
      have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
        (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
      have h3 : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs) = l ++ (l' ++ (r' ++ r)) := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs]
        simp only [l, l', r, r', List.append_assoc]
      have e : ∀ χ η, φs' ++ χ :: η :: φs = φs' ++ [χ, η] ++ φs := fun _ _ => by simp
      calc ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs)
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF l) * ι (ofCrAnListF l') * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            ι (ofCrAnListF r') * ι (ofCrAnListF r)) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            simp only [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc,
              mul_smul_comm, ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append,
              List.nil_append, ofList_singleton, map_sub, map_smul, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF,
              sub_right_inj]
          rw [smul_comm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, e, h1, h2, map_mul, mul_assoc, ofCrAnListF_append,
            l, l', r, r', hmid, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul_comm,
            smul_mul_assoc]
        _ = ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs) := by
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
              mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
              ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← h3,
              crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
              ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [map_smul, mul_smul_comm]
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, mul_zero, smul_zero]

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}

          (Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) (hEs j))
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt

          𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by

            (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t))]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, 𝓕.c_sq, mul_comm]
        ring
